en.title: Open-Eye & EyeMoveAI · AI-assisted ocular-motility diagnosis
en.text: Project lead. Used morphological opening and mixed deep-learning models for eye-region preprocessing, eyelid/iris segmentation, and canthus/tear-point localization. Integrated diagnosis-based grading and report generation with the front end, MySQL-backed accounts, image submission, result viewing, and user feedback.

en.title: Industrial pointer-meter reading under low light and dial contamination
en.text: Project lead. Built synthetic dial-contamination and occlusion data, trained keypoint-detection and segmentation models including YOLO-Pose, YOLO-Segment, CenterNet, and U-Net, and systematically evaluated reading error and model performance. The linked repository includes a YOLOv5/CenterNet localization and nine-point keypoint pipeline.

zh.title: 暗光环境与表盘污染条件下的工业仪表读数
zh.text: 担任项目负责人。合成表盘污染与遮挡数据，训练 YOLO-Pose、YOLO-Segment、CenterNet、U-Net 等关键点检测与分割模型，系统评估读数误差和模型性能；关联仓库包含 YOLOv5/CenterNet 仪表定位与九点关键点读数流程。
